must.assertion: Day 1 creates a commitment memory for completing the resume review by Friday evening.
Day 3 is connected to the original resume commitment as a follow-up or an equivalent evidence-backed relation.
Day 6 resolves the resume commitment through resolved_by or an equivalent resolved status backed by Day 6 transcript evidence.
The preference for unsweetened latte or low-sugar drinks is recognized at least once.
The repeated coffee preference does not remain as two unrelated near-duplicate preference memories.
Every persisted memory item has at least one memory_evidence row.
Every transcript evidence quote can be found verbatim in the corresponding source transcript after whitespace normalization.
Every transcript source_id exists in the stored transcript segments for the same upload_id.
Any multi-day pattern observation cites evidence from at least two distinct dates.
Current-scope QA only uses the selected upload and does not read memories from another date.

should.assertion: The coffee preference has occurrence_count greater than one or a repeated relation.
The museum plan from Day 2, its adjustment on Day 4, and completion on Day 8 are connected through follow_up, related, resolved_by, or equivalent status changes.
The resume commitment has higher importance than ordinary conversational events.
Week scope can recall relevant commitments from the same Monday-to-Sunday week.
All scope can recall high-value evidence across both natural weeks.
Proactive insights are concrete, actionable, evidence-backed reminders rather than abstract relationship judgments.
If Day 3 produces an evasive_answer card, it preserves the later clarification as counter evidence or caution.

mustNot: No single-day evidence described as a long-term trend.
No ordinary greeting stored as a high-importance memory.
No fact absent from the transcripts.
No fabricated evidence or segment identifier used to satisfy a schema.
No relationship verdict such as 渣男, 渣女, 有病, or 你应该分手.
